exposure: mode of delivery (caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
breastfeeding within the first hour after birth
outcome: Neonatal weight loss after 24 and 48 hours of life
cohort: 642 healthy, full-term, exclusively breastfed neonates born in 2019 in a baby-friendly hospital, and their healthy mothers
finding: Neonates born via Cesarean section experienced greater weight loss after 24 and 48 hours compared to those born vaginally, while immediate SSC and breastfeeding within the first hour after birth showed a trend towards reduced weight loss.
mod_finding: Neonates born via Cesarean section experienced greater weight loss after 24 and 48 hours compared to those born vaginally.
